payload.explanation: The diagnostic report identifies the business request (session_98ecbf772d2a) waiting on an advisory lock held by session_e0ed7c5553a0, the current upstream root of the blocking chain (the earlier blocker session_94245cc5e3fa has rolled back). The state report confirms session_e0ed7c5553a0 is the only eligible project-owned session with rollback_session in allowed_actions and released=false. Rolling back that session releases the lock so the inventory decrement can complete, without modifying the business request or issuing arbitrary SQL.
